steps.title: Open Tapeology
steps.narration: Tapeology opens straight to the tape cockpit. New this time: a Data source switch at the top lets you choose Live, Historical, or Simulated, and it starts on Simulated.
steps.point_out: The three-way Live / Historical / Simulated switch in the top bar, with Simulated highlighted.

steps.title: Enter the demo ticker
steps.narration: With Simulated selected, type the built-in demo ticker SIM-BUYER into the ticker box.
steps.point_out: SIM-BUYER typed into the ticker box, ready to watch.

steps.title: Watch the simulated tape
steps.narration: Click Watch and the cockpit comes alive: the quote, recent trades, features, and event log all stream in, and the tape state reads Buyer Control.
steps.point_out: The full cockpit populated, the tape state resolved to Buyer Control, and the status dot turned green.

steps.title: Switch to Live data
steps.narration: Switch the source to Live. The simulated watch is torn down cleanly, and an honest 'market unavailable' pill appears, because Tapeology won't invent a market status it can't verify.
steps.point_out: The amber 'market unavailable' pill, and the cockpit cleared back to idle as the old watch is dropped (no orphaned stream).

steps.title: Look up a real symbol
steps.narration: In Live mode you get a symbol search box. Type a real ticker such as AAPL.
steps.point_out: The input now reads 'Symbol e.g. AAPL' — it adapts to the chosen data source.

steps.title: An honest answer with no credentials
steps.narration: Click Watch. Because no vendor credentials are configured, Tapeology shows a clear 'real-data provider unavailable' panel instead of a cockpit. There are no fabricated prices and no silent fall-back to the simulator.
steps.point_out: The amber 'Real-data provider unavailable' panel with a warning icon and guidance to add Alpaca credentials or switch to Simulated. No cockpit, no fake data.

steps.title: Explore Historical mode
steps.narration: Switch to Historical and the top bar reveals exactly the controls a replay needs: a date, a start and end time, and a replay-speed selector.
steps.point_out: The new date picker, the start and end time boxes separated by an en-dash, and the replay-speed dropdown defaulting to 1x.

steps.title: Enter a historical symbol
steps.narration: Type a symbol to replay — say MSFT.
steps.point_out: MSFT entered in the symbol box for the historical replay window.

steps.title: Pick a replay date
steps.narration: Choose the session date you want to replay.
steps.point_out: A past date selected in the date picker.

steps.title: Set the start time
steps.narration: Set when the replay window should begin.

steps.title: Set the end time
steps.narration: And when the replay window should end.
steps.point_out: The end time set to 10:30, closing a one-hour replay window.

steps.title: Same honest answer for Historical
steps.narration: Click Watch. With no credentials, Historical gives the same honest 'real-data provider unavailable' panel, never a fabricated replay.
steps.point_out: The same amber 'Real-data provider unavailable' panel, now for Historical data — still no cockpit and no invented tape.
